text_block_list.text:
I'm on the rooftop taking a break from
work when
I see Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer... Fancy meeting... you
here...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I am currently afflicted by a
headache.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But do not worry. It is only throbbing a
little and
does not impact my normal
activi—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... And I consumed some painkillers
with
plenty of water earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I will... recover... during this...
class...

Her headache seems so bad that the
painkillers
are ineffective. I better think
of another way to
deal with it.
